mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCEDURE_LOG_MST (LOG_ID, APPLY_DATE, PROCEDURE_ID, JOB_TYPE, COMPANY_CODE, INPUT_PARAMETER, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, RESULT_CODE, RESULT_MESSAGE) VALUES (#{logId}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{procedureId}, #{jobType}, #{companyCode}, #{inputParameter}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, 'N', NULL, NULL)

INSERT INTO PROCEDURE_LOG_DTL (LOG_ID, SEQ, LOG_DATETIME, LOG_CONTENTS) VALUES (#{logId}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM PROCEDURE_LOG_DTL WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{logContents})
